core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; Specialty Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare Products; Home Healthcare Supplies and Equipment; Logistics and Commercialization Services
specialty_focus: Cencora is a global healthcare solutions company and one of the largest pharmaceutical distributors in the world. It specializes in distributing brand-name, generic, and specialty pharmaceuticals, as well as OTC products and home healthcare supplies, with a strong focus on complex therapies such as oncology, rheumatology, and rare diseases. It provides services including patient access, clinical support, and data analytics for specialty medications, operating through U.S. and International Healthcare Solutions segments.
